patterns.note: The main navigation bar (containing the logo, search, and login) becomes sticky at the top of the viewport after scrolling past the initial top utility bar and the hero carousel.
Extensive use of a responsive card-based grid system to display diverse course offerings, specializations, and categories, maintaining visual consistency across numerous content types.
A vibrant brand blue is consistently used for primary calls-to-action, links, and key interactive elements, contrasting with a predominantly white and light blue background palette.
Content is organized into distinct, self-contained sections, often introduced by a clear heading and followed by a grid of related cards, facilitating easy scanning of a large content library.
Headings utilize a bold, sans-serif typeface for strong hierarchy, while body text uses a highly legible, slightly lighter sans-serif, ensuring readability across detailed course descriptions.

technique_notes: The main navigation bar is implemented to transition from a static position to a fixed, sticky position at the top of the viewport once the user scrolls past the initial header and hero content, ensuring persistent access to core navigation.

Content is structured using a flexible grid system where individual course or program entries are presented as distinct cards, each with a subtle shadow or border, allowing for scalable display of a large catalog.
Promotional content is delivered via a full-width hero carousel that cycles through multiple visually distinct banners, each featuring a unique offering and call to action.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are bold and range from large hero text (~3-4x body) to medium section titles (~1.5-2x body), while body text is a clear, readable sans-serif.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on cards, buttons, and input fields, creating a soft but not overly playful feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced, with ample vertical padding between major sections and within card elements, contributing to a clean and organized presentation.

standout: The site's strength lies in its ability to present an immense catalog of educational content with exceptional clarity and organization. The consistent application of a card-based grid system, combined with a strong brand blue for calls to action, makes navigating and discovering relevant courses remarkably efficient without feeling overwhelming.
